entries.value: Raiders are taking refuge in their lands after striking ours
Ownership of a resource site — a mine, a ford, a fishing ground — is disputed
A usurper or criminal is being sheltered by them
A troublemaking religious sect is based in their territory
Their rulers have a political claim on our throne or on land we hold
A diplomatic marriage has gone sour — insults were given, a bride mistreated
A past war's savagery has left deep scars that have not healed
Their culture or religion is supplanting local beliefs among our people
Their immigrants are gaining great influence in border communities
They broke off an alliance or an important oath
They lured away a respected scholar, holy man, or craftsman
Border tariffs and tolls are blocking trade and enriching bandits
They drove a terrible monster or cursed tribe into our land
A faerie mound or Roman ruin they tampered with has sent evil into our territory
They woke up a great peril from the past
They are cooperating with our enemies — harbouring Saxon scouts, supplying raiders
They are suspected of backing assassinations or palace intrigues here
A spy ring operating from their court has been found or is suspected
They refused to give aid for some current crisis
They have been hostile to an allied group or vassal of ours
